note: Machine-readable source of truth for slate's component class strings. Every class token here is validated against designs/slate/index.html by scripts/check.mjs (a hover:/active:/disabled:/focus-visible: token is satisfied by its static form in the demo), so this file cannot drift from the kitchen sink. The prose reference in DESIGN.md ('Component notes') is the human-readable view of the same strings. Values are Tailwind utility classes routed through the tokens in shared/TOKENS.md — never a raw colour. cva components give base + variants; the rest give a base className and named parts/states.

button.base: inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 whitespace-nowrap rounded-md text-sm font-medium transition-colors duration-150 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:ring-offset-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-background disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50
button.docs: Icons inside a button are h-4 w-4 (16px), Lucide, 2px stroke; base gap-2 spaces them. Icon-only buttons use size=icon and must carry an aria-label. active:*/80 is the pressed step from the Motion table; the demo shows it as a static swatch.

badge.base: inline-flex items-center rounded-full px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium

statusPill.docs: Signals state, never decoration. The status word is in the text; a leading dot repeats the colour. Never colour alone.

intent.success: inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full bg-chart-3/10 px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium text-chart-3
intent.warning: inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full bg-chart-4/10 px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium text-chart-4
intent.error: inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full bg-destructive/10 px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium text-destructive
intent.info: inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full bg-primary/10 px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium text-primary
intent.neutral: inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full bg-muted px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground

input.base: flex h-9 w-full rounded-md border border-input bg-background px-3 py-1 text-sm shadow-xs transition-colors placeholder:text-muted-foreground focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:ring-offset-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-background

states.error: flex h-9 w-full rounded-md border border-destructive bg-background px-3 py-1 text-sm shadow-xs transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-destructive focus-visible:ring-offset-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-background
states.disabled: flex h-9 w-full cursor-not-allowed rounded-md border border-input bg-muted px-3 py-1 text-sm opacity-50 shadow-xs

input.docs: border-input is a darker grey than border on purpose (see Colour) — do not replace it with border. On error the border colour changes but its width does not.

textarea.base: flex w-full rounded-md border border-input bg-background px-3 py-2 text-sm shadow-xs transition-colors placeholder:text-muted-foreground focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:ring-offset-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-background
textarea.docs: Same field treatment as Input, but px-3 py-2 and no fixed height. The kitchen sink's example adds font-mono only because it holds a build command; that is not part of the base.

select.docs: Closed trigger is a native <select> styled as a field. The open form is the APG select-only combobox rendered inline in #inputs.

parts.trigger: flex h-9 w-full appearance-none rounded-md border border-input bg-background py-1 pl-3 pr-9 text-sm shadow-xs transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:ring-offset-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-background
parts.chevron: pointer-events-none absolute right-3 top-1/2 h-4 w-4 -translate-y-1/2 text-muted-foreground
parts.comboboxTrigger: flex h-9 w-full cursor-default items-center justify-between gap-2 rounded-md border border-input bg-background px-3 py-1 text-sm shadow-xs transition-colors focus:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:ring-offset-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-background
parts.listbox: mt-1 w-full rounded-lg border border-border bg-popover p-1 text-popover-foreground shadow-md
parts.option: flex h-8 w-full items-center gap-2 rounded-sm px-2 text-sm transition-colors hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground
parts.optionSelected: flex h-8 w-full items-center gap-2 rounded-sm px-2 text-sm font-medium transition-colors hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground
parts.optionActive: flex h-8 w-full items-center gap-2 rounded-sm bg-accent px-2 text-sm text-accent-foreground

parts.box: flex h-4 w-4 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-sm border border-input bg-background shadow-xs
parts.boxChecked: flex h-4 w-4 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-sm border border-primary bg-primary text-primary-foreground shadow-xs

checkbox.docs: Checked and indeterminate share boxChecked; the check glyph is 3px stroke. Indeterminate sets aria-checked=mixed.

parts.outer: flex h-4 w-4 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full border border-input bg-background shadow-xs
parts.outerSelected: flex h-4 w-4 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full border border-primary bg-background shadow-xs

parts.trackOff: inline-flex h-5 w-9 shrink-0 items-center rounded-full border border-transparent bg-input p-0.5 shadow-xs transition-colors
parts.trackOn: inline-flex h-5 w-9 shrink-0 items-center rounded-full border border-transparent bg-primary p-0.5 shadow-xs transition-colors
parts.thumb: h-4 w-4 rounded-full bg-background shadow-sm transition-transform
parts.thumbOn: h-4 w-4 translate-x-4 rounded-full bg-background shadow-sm transition-transform

parts.thumb: h-4 w-4 -translate-x-1/2 rounded-full border border-primary bg-background shadow-sm

parts.title: text-xl font-semibold tracking-[-0.015em]
parts.footer: flex items-center justify-end gap-2 border-t border-border px-6 py-4

card.docs: Border, no shadow — a card sits in the page, not above it.

table.docs: Wrap in overflow-x-auto with a real <caption>. Sortable header is a <button> inside the <th>, and the <th> carries aria-sort. Numeric columns are text-right + tabular-nums. Row actions reveal with opacity/:focus-within, never display:none.

parts.surface: rounded-lg border border-border bg-popover p-1 text-popover-foreground shadow-md
parts.item: flex h-8 w-full items-center gap-2.5 rounded-sm px-2 text-sm transition-colors hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground
parts.itemActive: flex h-8 w-full items-center gap-2.5 rounded-sm bg-accent px-2 text-sm text-accent-foreground
parts.itemDestructive: flex h-8 w-full items-center gap-2.5 rounded-sm px-2 text-sm text-destructive transition-colors hover:bg-destructive/10
parts.label: px-2 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground

menu.docs: Dialogs use the same surface but shadow-lg and a padded body, not p-1.

intent.info: flex gap-3 rounded-lg border border-border bg-muted/40 p-4
intent.success: flex gap-3 rounded-lg border border-chart-3/30 bg-chart-3/10 p-4
intent.warning: flex gap-3 rounded-lg border border-chart-4/30 bg-chart-4/10 p-4
intent.destructive: flex gap-3 rounded-lg border border-destructive/30 bg-destructive/10 p-4

parts.title: text-sm font-medium
parts.actionLink: inline-block text-sm font-medium text-primary underline-offset-4 hover:underline

alert.docs: Intent is carried by the icon and a /10 tinted background, never a heavy coloured left bar.

parts.root: w-64 rounded-lg border border-sidebar-border bg-sidebar p-2 text-sidebar-foreground
parts.item: flex h-8 items-center gap-2.5 rounded-md px-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground transition-colors hover:bg-sidebar-accent hover:text-sidebar-accent-foreground
parts.itemActive: flex h-8 items-center gap-2.5 rounded-md bg-sidebar-accent px-2 text-sm font-medium text-sidebar-accent-foreground
parts.groupLabel: px-2 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground

sidebarNav.docs: Uses the --sidebar-* tokens, one step off the page background. Active item also carries aria-current=page; no left accent bar.

parts.bar: flex gap-1 overflow-x-auto pt-1.5 -mt-1.5 pb-1.5 -mb-[7px] pl-1.5 -ml-1.5 pr-1.5 -mr-1.5
parts.tabActive: shrink-0 whitespace-nowrap border-b-2 border-primary px-4 pt-3 pb-3 text-sm font-medium text-foreground focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:rounded-t-md
parts.tab: shrink-0 whitespace-nowrap border-b-2 border-transparent px-4 pt-3 pb-3 text-sm text-muted-foreground transition-colors hover:border-border hover:text-foreground focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:rounded-t-md
parts.segmentedWrap: inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-md bg-muted p-1
parts.segmentSelected: inline-flex h-7 items-center rounded-sm bg-background px-3 text-sm font-medium shadow-xs focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring
parts.segment: inline-flex h-7 items-center rounded-sm px-3 text-sm text-muted-foreground transition-colors hover:text-foreground focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring

tabs.docs: Underline style, not shadcn's filled pill. The bar sits under a border-b border-border. Vertical tabs use the sidebar item treatment (active bg-accent), not an underline.
